data.narrative:
Manna Aero is a Series B-stage drone and autonomous systems company that has raised $110M to date. The relevant peer universe comprises 8 private companies in the Drones & Autonomous sector, including Elroy Air, Waymo, Wayve, Zipline, and Joby Aviation. No public comparables exist in this narrow segment.

Given sparse same-stage and adjacent-stage peer data, a Peer-Median approach was not feasible—only 1 same-stage comparable was identified within the sector, falling short of the 3-point minimum for reliable triangulation. Consequently, valuation relies on Stage-Progression methodology, which applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier to the $110M total-raised proxy, a typical advancement factor between Series B and subsequent rounds. This approach yields an implied valuation of $209M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $178M to $240M, centered on $209M. The range reflects standard variance around stage-progression estimates. Key uncertainties include the scarcity of directly comparable Series B financings in this sector, which limits peer benchmarking precision, and the heterogeneity of business models across the broader Drones & Autonomous universe. A more granular valuation would require additional same-stage transaction data or disclosure of Manna Aero's specific operational metrics.
